milestone.describes: A track is playing: the theme loads, the note chart scrolls and the audio runs.

steps.expect: The title screen with Play. Allow 40 s — startup got slower once views started receiving a real layout pass.
The track loads — about 30 s of it — and then plays: the theme is up, the note chart scrolls and the audio runs.

notes: Coordinates are client coordinates for the 320x480 portrait window.
The waits here are the route, not padding: 40 s to the title and about 30 s of loading after the track is picked. A replay that hurries taps a loading screen and looks like dead input.
This is a rhythm game, so the evidence for the milestone is the chart scrolling and the audio running, not a single frame.
